excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
Here's the problem, there's no really nice way of solving this on block auctions
- Withdrawals are part of the payload hash
- Payload hash is committed in the payload
- Beacon block is not known at the time the payload is built and committed
- Some withdrawals may be invalidated by the beacon block

So either we make some withdrawals a no-op, or we keep as we are. There are some other options, all are a little uglier.
